name: ping-a-human
description: A Telegram message when a session needs you; tap Allow or Deny there and the answer waits beside the prompt as a suggestion you confirm with your passkey.

settings.label: ping-a-human config
settings.help: Run `npx ping-a-human setup` once; it writes the bot token and chat id here.

settings.label: Ask Allow / Deny on a permission prompt
settings.help: The tap becomes a suggestion in the GUI; nothing is sent to the machine until you confirm it with your passkey.

settings.label: Wait before sending (seconds)
settings.help: A prompt answered at the desk within this time sends nothing.
